name: caisse_v1_finalisation_readiness
episode_body: Caisse V1 finalisation review on 2026-04-26 reconciled the old mega-plan reports with the completed masterplay queue. Current state: all CV1 masterplay missions are CLOSED except CV1-M04A-PAYMENT-LEDGER-FULL, which is intentionally BLOCKED because GATE_PAYMENT_LEDGER_V1 selected Option B Restricted pilot. The old verdict READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION:NO_WITHOUT_GATES is superseded by implementation completion for the selected V1 scope; the remaining blocker is release evidence, not another broad product-code wave. New artifacts: reports/audit/ULTRA_REVIEW_CAISSE_V1_FINALISATION_2026-04-26.md and plans/PLAN_CAISSE_V1_FINALISATION_SUPER_PLAN_2026-04-26.md. Key decision: no new product code unless final proofs fail. Next task is CV1-FR-00-STATE-INVENTORY, followed by governance reconciliation, full regression, build reproducibility, staging migration rehearsal, runtime ops proof, hardware lab execution, critical E2E, fiscal evidence, security red-team, operator UAT, runbook drill, release decision packet, and pilot watch setup. GO remains HOLD until final release evidence and human final gate.
